items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Not Sam Duce, but his daddy.

ctx.x: That was where his brother was on the place. Now, in the rhythm. He was. Oh. And we go to the Pelican. We played the Pelican about three, four years. Uh-huh. See? And I played on the Pelican. Depression was coming in. I come in all the time. I played in the Nola band until about. He said, I didn't know the band. I don't know. I don't want to play. And the Nola band was changed to the Silverton officer. That's the time old man Duce had taken the band over. Old man Duce. Not Sam Duce, but his daddy.
